title: Pastel color in audiovisual projects: study of effects on viewers' emotions
core_idea: Investigate whether audiovisual production using pastel versus saturated color designs alters the emotions perceived by viewers by creating 12 videos (six pastel, six saturated) each targeting one of six basic emotions and collecting viewer reports.
tldr: Controlled comparison of pastel and saturated color production in videos to assess differences in perceived intensity across six basic emotions.
